The player — this is real

A .folio opens here with no install and no build step. Click a verb, then an object; click the compass to move. The cellar is locked until you find the key in the hall, and dark until you light the lantern.

Loading the game…

What certification means

TierProves
T0 schemaThe manifest is complete and well-formed
T1 integrityEvery reference resolves; assets decode; capabilities are supported
T2 graphNo dead ends exist — computed from the world, not asserted
T3 replayOne path completes — cold start, no state injection, no privileged verbs
T4 designIt is a game: chain depth, item economy, map shape, pacing

Calibrated against Zork I, measured rather than estimated: 82 rooms, 0.67 loops per room, a 43% take rate, a reward every 11.5 moves, and one 69-move stretch with no reward at all. “Playable” means a path exists — not that a human can find it.

Your game goes here

Bring a story and the Studio turns it into a playable .folio. You steer, the compiler builds, and the validator proves it is finishable before it ships.
